content: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II is described as written for Bāysunghur b. Shāhrukh some five years after the events of 830/1427, angrier in tone, detailing his wanderings and his inability to support ten children and a few wives; footnote 105 dates it between ca. 832-35/1429-32 from his own remarks (five years since exile, nine months since the promise of review).
